claim: HackerOne report 341876 was submitted by 0xacb on 22 April 2018 and disclosed 23 May 2018; Shopify classified it as SSRF in Exchange.
locator: JSON title reporter.username submitted_at disclosed_at weakness.name structured_scope.asset_identifier
qualification: The report title says all instances but the Shopify team summary narrows impact to one subset.

claim: The researcher edited a store password.liquid template to navigate the Exchange listing screenshot browser to the Google metadata service.
evidence: window.location to metadata.google.internal from a seller-controlled template; listing PNG
qualification: This was a headless-browser screenshot surface, not a direct webhook URL fetch.

claim: The v1beta1 metadata endpoint returned a service-account token without Metadata-Flavor Google.
locator: JSON vulnerability_information section 1 paragraph after screenshot step
evidence: v1beta1 path; no Metadata-Flavor header; token in PNG
qualification: Researcher's account; later metadata requests were separate.

claim: Separate requests exposed kube-env with kubelet certificate and key; further steps obtained a service-account token and root shell in containers.
evidence: kube-env; cert and key; pod secret; root shell
qualification: The original instance token alone was not enough for Compute Engine write access.

claim: Shopify said the vulnerable screenshot service was disabled within an hour and the affected infrastructure was one subset excluding Shopify core.
evidence: within an hour; one subset; Shopify core not included
qualification: Vendor summary resolves the report title's overbroad all-instances wording.

claim: Shopify deployed a metadata concealment proxy and disabled access to internal IPs on all infrastructure subsets.
evidence: metadata concealment proxy; internal IP access disabled

claim: Shopify awarded 25000 dollars as a Shopify Core RCE bounty despite the vulnerable subset excluding Shopify core.
evidence: $25,000 as Shopify Core RCE; subset did not include Shopify core
qualification: Some applications in the subset had access to core data and systems.

claim: Shopify's 3 April 2019 engineering article recaps the Exchange SSRF and 25000-dollar bounty.
locator: Published on Apr 3 2019; article body section Three of our most interesting resolved bugs
qualification: The blog repeats the team's summary; the HackerOne report is the detailed primary record.
